title: Sequential per-number marginal change detection with global FWER control

excluded_row.reason: official archive still lists contest 315 as pending; secondary-source corroboration is not accepted as canonical primary provenance

hypothesis: A persistent change in one or more individual number-inclusion rates may be detectable by an exact two-half conditional test, and sparse alarm-gated adaptation may improve prequential subset log-loss or marginal Brier versus uniform and unconditional recency weighting.

design.per_target_update_order: Score target using only the immediately preceding 200 eligible draws; append target only after all scores and flags for that target have been computed.

change_detection.test: Two-sided Fisher exact conditional test for each number's first-half count given its total count in the 200-draw window; under the stationary uniform null, the first-half count is Hypergeometric(N=200,K=total_in_window,n=100).
change_detection.family: All 3,204 targets x all 40 numbers; Bonferroni controls the complete repeated-scan family regardless of overlap/dependence.
change_detection.flag_rule: Flag number i at target t only if its exact two-sided conditional p-value is <= 0.05/(3204*40).

models.M1: Always-on recent-half frequency model: q_i=(c_recent_i+200*0.125)/(100+200); weight w_i=q_i/0.125; exact fixed-size subset distribution proportional to product of weights.
models.M2: Sparse alarm-gated model: start with w_i=1 for all numbers; only for numbers passing the globally Bonferroni-controlled exact change test set w_i=q_i/0.125 using the same fixed recent-half shrinkage; all other weights remain 1.

scoring.joint_subset_log_loss: -log(P(S)); P(S)=product(w_i for i in S)/e5(w_1,...,w_40), where e5 is the exact fifth elementary symmetric polynomial.
scoring.marginal_brier: Mean squared error over 40 exact marginal inclusion probabilities derived from the same fixed-size subset distribution.
scoring.direction: Positive gain means baseline loss minus model loss > 0.

inference.discovery_use: Descriptive only; no tuning or model selection.

integrity.future_suffix_invariance: Recompute selected target forecasts after perturbing all subsequent draws; prior forecast and alarm must remain unchanged.
integrity.fixed_size_normalization: Enumerate/DP exact e5; subset probabilities normalized and marginal inclusion probabilities sum to 5.
integrity.determinism: Fixed PRNG seed for resampling; exact Fisher p-values deterministic.
limitations: Exploratory within the broader Q00-Q139 research family; Holm covers Q140 endpoints, not all historical experiments.
Historical blind segment is not a virgin prospective sample.
The global FWER threshold is intentionally conservative; absence of alarms does not prove exact stationarity.
This is a marginal-drift diagnostic and does not test all possible higher-order dependence.
